create_SmoothedValue_tracker: create a SmoothedValue instance to track a rolling window of metric values with median and global average
update_MetricLogger_meters: update a MetricLogger with keyword arguments to record training metrics like loss and accuracy
log_MetricLogger_iterable: use MetricLogger log_every to iterate over a dataloader and print periodic training progress
create_default_loggers: call get_default_loggers to create train and validation MetricLogger instances with preset meters
setup_tensorboard_writer: call setup_tbx to create a TensorBoard SummaryWriter for the main process only
